If we know that she died in year 1046 and that she reigned for eleven years, can't we assume that her reign started in the year 1046 - 11 (i.e 1035) or thereabouts?  Instead of saying that the date of her reign is unknown, we should be able to say "Her reign started either in year 1035 or 1036; the actual year is not definitely known.
